objective: Generate distinct local and ChatGPT alternatives, compare with Jev as advisory classifier, and execute discriminators for whole-organism engine bottlenecks. No stage3 promotion from votes.
source_control: Parent and nominal-step variant remain controls, not counted among the minimum3alternatives.

domain_hypotheses.A: Analytical source-port projection rounds just beyond a saturated bound.
domain_hypotheses.B: An evolved target/rate/input violates the model domain materially.
domain_hypotheses.C: State ownership, stream order or rejected/predictor publication changes an input unexpectedly.

diagnostic: First load repeats previously failing fine1562 trajectory with error capture: final offending coordinates, all six stage projected states/targets/rates and before/after projection. Successful endpoints1/5ms must remain bit-identical to the previous same-method run. Retain error and raw payload. No clamp or acceptance change.
architecture_comparison: Freeze local proposals before reading new ChatGPT proposals; prior exposure to earlier discussion is declared. Select no more than2candidate implementations from evidence, not majority. Diagnostic and operator inspection do not count as numerical prototypes.

criteria.performance_scope: Measured full advance; small or synthetic fixtures only reject/justify a next step. No claimed1second without executing it.
criteria.events: Separate continuous-state errors from jump timing/count errors prospectively; do not apply a blanketcontinuous bound to discontinuities.

stopping: New located cause with bounded repair, completed discriminating milestone, exhaustion or interpretability failure. Do not increase the budget after a candidate fails. No mandatory new biological gate invented by external reviewers.
